findings.claim: The localhost check runs for every `scheme://` URL, not only ssh. An origin such as `http://localhost:3000/org/repo.git` or `https://127.0.0.1/repo.git` (a local git server like Gitea) was a network remote before and is now treated as local. Apply and capture then silently skip the push to it. The commit message only names scp forms, ssh URLs and file://. The new tests also cover only ssh and scp forms, so this wider behavior change is untested.

evidence: Traced the scp form for `git@localhost:overlay.git`, `localhost:/srv/x`, `[::1]:/srv/x` and `example.com:a@localhost:overlay.git`. All four are classified correctly by the new parsing.
The `*://*` branch parses the host without looking at the scheme, and the final case returns 1 for localhost hosts under any scheme, including http and https.
